import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from notes import read_note


class ReadNoteTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reads_a_note(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as base:
            with open(os.path.join(base, "a.txt"), "w") as f:
                f.write("hello")
            self.assertEqual(read_note(base, "a.txt"), "hello")

base.test/test_lines.py:
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from lines import count_lines


class CountLinesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_counts(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = os.path.join(d, "f.txt")
            with open(p, "w") as f:
                f.write("a\nb\n")
            self.assertEqual(count_lines(p), 2)

defect.description: the path is interpolated into a shell command (shell=True): command injection
